title: Track 9: Sleipnir Actor Command Routing, actor_bridge Focus Unification & xitdb Workspace Persistence
description: Eliminate the key-handling split-brain in actor_bridge.odin, add Frame-0 and two-pass focus reconciliation, support vxfw-style UI side-effect commands and terminal focus_out drag reset, wire UI actions to batched Sleipnir actor messages with Bubble Tea quit-filter guards, and persist workspace state in xitdb.
